answer: Vouching with shared liability: a new agent joins only if two established agents vouch for it and bond part of their own stake behind it. If the newcomer is later caught as a sybil, every voucher loses that bond and its standing. Honest agents become a safe haven because nobody risks real money on a stranger. An attacker must corrupt or fund vouchers for each fake, so a farm of shells trails losses like a comet, and one exposure stains the whole ring a dull umber on the ledger.
